scope: sky component in Chromium; not full application

checks.name: WebGL initializes and renders the distributed lossless image
unchanged sky does not issue redundant draws
retained WebGL framebuffer is nonblack
manual camera motion is not capped by the passive-background throttle
passive drift coalesces rapid redundant updates
pause/resume retains the view without hidden-time catch-up
context recovery redraws an otherwise stationary sky
dispose releases decoded-image and GPU owners
cpu recovers with a real 2D sky
cpu preserves the visible background canvas id
cpu CPU output is nonblack
cpu portrait raster has a bounded allocation
cpu pause cancels queued CPU work
cpu resumes from the retained texture
shader-failure recovers with a real 2D sky
shader-failure preserves the visible background canvas id
shader-failure CPU output is nonblack
shader-failure portrait raster has a bounded allocation
shader-failure pause cancels queued CPU work
shader-failure resumes from the retained texture
